meta.name: delegated-file-edit-verification
meta.description: Verify delegated file-edit results directly in the target workspace before accepting success, and rerun with absolute paths if the delegate's report conflicts with reality.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证文件编辑结果并自动修正路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要验证代理编辑的文件结果并处理路径冲突。
copy.tagline_en: Verify file edit results and auto-correct paths
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to verify delegated file edits and resolve path conflicts.

howto.what: 当其他代理或子进程报告文件已创建或修改后，Claude 会直接在工作区进行独立验证，检查文件存在性、路径、结构和行数等。如果发现不一致，会标记任务为未完成，并要求用绝对路径重新执行。
howto.when: 当其他代理、子进程或委托工具声称成功创建或修改了文件时触发，尤其是结构化文件（如电子表格、CSV、数据库等）。

say.text: 验证刚才生成的report.xlsx是否真的在工作区。
say.note: Claude 会检查文件是否存在、路径是否正确。

say.text: 检查delegate说创建好的data.csv的列头是否正确。
say.note: Claude 会读取CSV头行并比对。

say.text: 确认output/report.xlsx的sheet名称和行数是否和报告一致。
say.note: Claude 会打开文件检查内部结构。

howto.what_en: After a delegate or subprocess reports a file as created/modified, Claude independently verifies the result in the target workspace: checking existence, exact path, structure, row counts, etc. If mismatches are found, it marks the task incomplete and reruns with absolute paths.
howto.when_en: Triggered when another agent, subprocess, or delegated tool claims to have successfully created or modified a file, especially for structured files like spreadsheets, CSVs, or databases.

say_en.text: Verify that the report.xlsx just created actually exists in the workspace.
say_en.note: Claude checks file existence and path.

say_en.text: Check if the headers of data.csv that the delegate claimed are correct.
say_en.note: Claude reads the CSV header row and compares.

say_en.text: Confirm that the sheet names and row counts of output/report.xlsx match the report.
